modern: Does the light of the lamp shine without losing its brightness until it is put out? And shall the truth which is in you, and justice and self-control, be extinguished before your death?
original: Does the light of the lamp shine without losing its splendor until it is extinguished? and shall the truth which is in thee and justice and temperance be extinguished [before thy death]?
notification: Does the light of the lamp shine without losing its brightness until it is put out?
notification_original: Does the light of the lamp shine without losing its splendor until it is extinguished?
